thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: elevated error rate observed for /v1/generate across gateway (5xx + timeouts). Paging on-call.
maria: Acknowledged. I'm on it — will gather spike scope. @sam @kai FYI.
sam: On my way. Any customer-facing outages reported yet?
maria: Alerting shows 12% 5xx for the last 3m, median latency up to 2.4s. Error types: 502 + upstream timeouts. Traffic spike in eu-west region.
kai: I'm seeing a surge in backend queue length on model-proxy pods. KV cache miss rate jumped ~4x. Could be a cache eviction pattern after the deploy at ~1943216000.
devon: Which deploy? I have the changelist open: small env var tweak for autoscaling window rolled today at 1943209000. Not expecting failure but will double-check.
jess: Customer support flagged increased request failures from two enterprise tenants. Putting a banner on status if impact continues. :warning:
maria: Quick mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller model for the heavy tail 2) raise gateway circuit breaker to tolerate transient slow calls 3) scale proxy pool. I'll start 2+3 now.
ash: (ops note) I'm running: ``kubectl -n prod scale deployment model-proxy --replicas=16``
deploy-bot: Started rollout: scaled model-proxy from 8 -> 16 (revision: scale-1943216795). No pods crashed.
sam: Doing a config test for router rules. Suggest temporarily increase request timeout to 10s for /v1/generate so we avoid premature 502s while scaling warms up.
maria: Applied circuit breaker change: ``circuit.max_inflight = 300`` and router timeout bumped to 10s. Watching metrics.
kai: After scale, queue depth went down and 5xx rate dropped to 4% in 2m. Latency trending back toward normal.
jess: Support: customers still seeing errors but much reduced. I'll update impacted tenant threads: "reduced errors after mitigation, monitoring".
devon: Found root cause candidate: the env var change tightened the autoscaler cooldown which caused scale-downs during a burst window. Proxy cache eviction + cold-starts caused next-level failures.
maria: Good find. Immediate action items: rollback cooldown change in staging and prepare hotfix for prod config restore. Also create an alert to detect cache miss spikes.
ash: Creating incident checklist in the runbook now. Adding notes under "cache-eviction-regression".
sam: For postmortem: need metric thresholds for cache-miss, inflight and queue-depth. Propose thresholds: cache_miss_rate > 1% sustained over 2m triggers pager, queue_depth > 200 triggers scaling pre-warm.
jess: Also recommend we add a customer-impact tag in alerts so support can auto-surface tenants in the runbook.
maria: Quick hotfix: restoring autoscaler cooldown to previous value. Command: ``kubectl -n prod set env deployment/autoscaler COOLDOWN=180`` — will apply after approval.
kai: I pushed a branch with the runbook edits and a small alert rule patch: ``ops/alerts/cache-miss-threshold`` -> PR #4732.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: autoscaler env rollback applied (revision: rollback-1943216988).
maria: Monitoring shows 5xx down to 1.2% and p95 latency back to baseline. Leaving this thread open for follow-ups: hotfix PR link, runbook update, alert tuning, and a retro.
ash: Action items assigned: - devon: ship config hotfix to prod and validate autoscaler metrics (due: +2h) - kai: merge runbook + alert PR (due: +4h) - sam: add customer-impact tagging to alerts (due: +6h) - jess: draft customer comms and status page update (due: +1h)
jess: I'll also schedule a 30m blameless retro tomorrow.
maria: Closing active paging but keeping channel for any regressions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved (recovery confirmed). Logs and timeline saved to: https://internal.redwood/incident/1943216789
